name: Hydro / death

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A compressed water pocket suddenly collapses: a low hollow watery gulp, one dense splash and a short trickle fading out. Distinct underwater pressure death release.
